comparisons.peer_summary: Direct sales to a single distributor accounted for 28% and 21% of net revenue in fiscal years 2024 and 2023, with top five end customers representing approximately 40% and 35% respectively. The company expects significant customer concentration to continue and warns that loss of these customers could materially adversely affect business results.
comparisons.comparison: AVGO reports significant customer concentration with a single distributor accounting for 28% of net revenue in fiscal 2024 and the top five end customers representing approximately 40% of net revenue. This contrasts with NVDA, which discloses that there were no customers with 10% or more of total revenue in fiscal years 2023 and 2022, indicating a significantly more diversified customer base compared to AVGO's heavy reliance on a small number of key accounts.
